description: Customer reviews of franchise locations at review grain: review counts by franchise, country, city and size.
Franchise network at franchise grain: franchise counts by country, city and size, and supplier coverage and approval.
Customer-level purchase behaviour over all data: customers, repeat customer rate, revenue and transactions per customer.
Sales at transaction grain: revenue, units, transactions, average order value, product and payment mix by franchise, product and date.

question: How did weekly revenue change compared with the previous week?
sql: SELECT `Transaction Week` AS week, MEASURE(`Revenue`) AS revenue
SELECT week, revenue, revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY week) AS change_vs_previous_week

question: Which 5 franchises had the highest revenue?
sql: SELECT `Franchise ID`, `Franchise Name`, `Franchise Country`, MEASURE(`Revenue`) AS revenue

content: If a question gives no period, use all available data and state the date range it covers.
If a question needs data these metric views do not hold (costs, margins, staffing, inventory, review ratings or sentiment), say the data is not available instead of estimating it.
